failure_modes.trigger: Compiler receives only research-bundle.json and run-manifest.json without the referenced ContractGraph.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject compilation; IDs and hashes cannot be used to infer missing object payloads.

failure_modes.trigger: ContractGraph dependency closure, source graph, component lock, issuer, or cutoff differs from the reloaded Bundle.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the entire handoff run before Fact mapping.

failure_modes.trigger: Source authority is not primary_regulatory or company_primary for a model Fact.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Keep the evidence outside the kernel ledger and mark required mapping blocked.

failure_modes.trigger: Source identity, URL, publication/retrieval time, exact locator, or content hash cannot be closed.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject SourceRef creation; never invent title, publisher, or locator metadata.

failure_modes.trigger: Research Fact is nonnumeric, future-dated, cross-issuer, or low-confidence.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Exclude it and block any required kernel field that depends on it.

failure_modes.trigger: Research concept has no exact versioned kernel mapping.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject it; fuzzy concept matching is prohibited.

failure_modes.trigger: Stock/flow period is incomplete, inverted, ambiguous, or replaced by publication date.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the mapped Fact.

failure_modes.trigger: Monetary Fact currency differs from kernel reporting currency under rc.1.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Block readiness; do not fabricate an FX conversion or break parent lineage.

failure_modes.trigger: Unit family or scale is unregistered, or per-share/total/percent/decimal semantics conflict.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject deterministic unit conversion.

failure_modes.trigger: CalculationResult uses an Assumption, unregistered calculator, external Observation, or unreplayable hash.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Do not convert it into a kernel derived Fact.

failure_modes.trigger: Derived Fact omits parents/derivation or a parent is not mapped.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the derived Fact and all descendants.

failure_modes.trigger: Claim, Review, Hypothesis, Statement, Observation, or LLM output is converted into a numeric kernel Fact.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the graph and record a domain-isolation violation.

failure_modes.trigger: ResearchBundle complete is used as a substitute for method readiness.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Recompute separate readiness and preserve partial/specialist/blocked states.

failure_modes.trigger: Company classification or routing uses a fabricated numeric flag or evidence-free assertion.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject routing compilation.

failure_modes.trigger: Balance-sheet Facts are misaligned, dependent plugs, or fail reconciliation.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Block accounting readiness and kernel request compilation.

failure_modes.trigger: Clean-surplus stocks/flows are misaligned or require an invented plug.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Block the affected method and request.

failure_modes.trigger: Method adjustment has market lineage, a raw amount, disallowed target, or incomplete parent facts.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the adjustment and readiness promotion.

failure_modes.trigger: Adjustment roots are reused across groups or one economic item is counted in both method views without explicit separate policy.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject method-view compilation.

failure_modes.trigger: Any of nine equity-bridge roles is omitted or caller-forged as resolved.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Keep the role unresolved and prevent complete McKinsey readiness.

failure_modes.trigger: No disclosure or completed search is represented as zero or explicitly_absent.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the assertion; absence requires affirmative official evidence.

failure_modes.trigger: Option/SBC dilution is counted in both diluted shares and a bridge claim, or another bridge claim is duplicated.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject equity-bridge compilation.

failure_modes.trigger: Research Assumption, management guidance, or moat hypothesis directly creates a kernel assumption.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the assumption; require a valuation Candidate and human Decision.

failure_modes.trigger: Candidate fingerprint, evidence graph, scope, unit, horizon, or scenario differs from its Decision.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Invalidate the Decision and keep the Candidate unapproved.

failure_modes.trigger: Assumption concept/scope/scenario or source Fact lineage violates the pinned AssumptionLedger controls.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject kernel assumption compilation.

failure_modes.trigger: McKinsey does not have exactly black_swan, bear, base, and bull or uses inconsistent timelines.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Do not freeze price-blind input.

failure_modes.trigger: McKinsey assumption or referenced Fact has market-price lineage.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Invalidate the run and quarantine accessed market evidence.

failure_modes.trigger: Penman near-term, hurdle, growth-grid, or challenge-path assumption remains mutable at price access.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Do not authorize MarketReferenceSnapshot acquisition.

failure_modes.trigger: Market source is accessed before a valid price-blind fingerprint and protected hashes exist.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Invalidate the run; do not reuse the quote to revise assumptions.

failure_modes.trigger: price-blind-input.json is labeled or validated as a complete valuation-request.json.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the artifact because market_equity_value_fact_id is deliberately absent.

failure_modes.trigger: Quote identity, timestamp, cutoff, currency, split state, source, or retrieval metadata is incomplete.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Block MarketReferenceSnapshot and final request.

failure_modes.trigger: Market equity value is hand-entered or does not round-trip to quote times reviewed diluted shares.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject market Fact creation.

failure_modes.trigger: Market evidence enters routing, accounting, method adjustments, assumptions, or McKinsey lineage.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject final request and invalidate the run.

failure_modes.trigger: Assumption entries differ before and after market Facts are appended.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject final request; only fact_ledger_fingerprint binding may change.

failure_modes.trigger: protected_mckinsey_sha256 or protected_penman_assumptions_sha256 changes after market access.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject final request and archive.

failure_modes.trigger: Final request omits a required pinned-schema field or contains a forbidden weighting key.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Do not invoke the kernel.
failure_modes.verification: Pinned request-schema and adversarial weighting tests.

failure_modes.trigger: Kernel tag, commit, package, component lock, or any of eight schema hashes drifts.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Do not invoke or accept output from the dependency.

failure_modes.trigger: Research layer recalculates, edits, rounds, relabels, averages, or selectively omits kernel result content.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject ValuationHandoff; archive only the validated canonical kernel result.
